passage: The forecast had changed several times during the week. Neither the coach nor the players ______ expecting the storm to cancel the championship game, so everyone arrived at the stadium on time.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: With "neither…nor", the verb agrees with the subject closer to it.
The closer subject is "the players", which is plural.
So the verb must be plural: "were."
key: With either/or and neither/nor, match the verb to the nearer subject.
